label: Charleston (3D: a character dances on the card)

preset.title: The Charleston
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it and keep it in view. The band strikes up.
body: Pearls on, shoes polished, champagne poured: tonight the whole floor is yours, and I have saved you every dance.
Happy birthday. Here's to another year of laughing too loud and dancing till the lights come up.
preset.from: Yours, with a twirl and a toast

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that comes up when the dance ends. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.
